mentions.heading: Enterprise data practices subject to increasingly complex, restrictive, and punitive regulations
mentions.detail: Subject to CCPA/CPRA, EU GDPR, EU AI Act, UK Data Protection Act; compliance costs rising, AI adoption intensifies risk
mentions.quote: Complying with these new laws has significantly increased, and may continue to increase, our operating costs and is driving increased complexity in our operations.

mentions.heading: Operations subject to extensive laws including vehicle emissions and fuel economy standards
mentions.detail: Fuel economy/GHG rules may limit profitable ICE sales, require credit purchases, penalties; unharmonized jurisdictions, possible sales mandates
mentions.quote: these regulations could require us to further limit the sale of certain profitable ICE products in current and future years, subsidize the sale of less profitable ones, change our manufacturing processes, pay increased penalties, purchase additional credits from our competitors or undertake other activities that may require us to incur additional expense, which may be material.

mentions.heading: Proposed GHG rule changes could impair emissions credits
mentions.detail: Proposed GHG standard changes could impair emissions credits, as with prior CAFE credit impairment
mentions.quote: In addition, proposed regulatory changes to the GHG emissions standards could result in an impairment of our emissions credits, similar to the previous impairment we recognized related to our CAFE credits.

mentions.heading: Limits on ability to achieve fuel economy improvements
mentions.detail: EV infrastructure gaps, battery raw material supply, consumer acceptance may prevent profitable EV sales needed for compliance
mentions.quote: There is no assurance that we will be able to produce and sell vehicles that use such new technologies on a profitable basis or that our customers will purchase such vehicles in the quantities necessary for us to comply with current or future regulatory requirements.
